title: SpaceX S-1: xAI plans to buy another $2.8B worth of turbines for its data centers, including a $2B deal for mobile gas turbines, the type it's being sued over (Tim De Chant/TechCrunch)
summary: Tim De Chant / TechCrunch: SpaceX S-1: xAI plans to buy another $2.8B worth of turbines for its data centers, including a $2B deal for mobile gas turbines, the type it's being sued over — Elon Musk's xAI has gotten itself in hot water over its use of polluting generators at its data center near Memphis, Tennessee.
